items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Haggart -- bass player -- Bobby Haggart -- he was the leader of the band... I was just there... He didn't have to do it. You know, I wasn't the leader, I was just there.

ctx.x: That was her only problem. I got a fine one time -- pickin' her up to carry her to one of the sessions -- recording sessions. And they fined me. Johnny Haggart -- bass player -- Bobby Haggart -- he was the leader of the band. the

know I couldn't read you know. But I think he took it out on me, just for bein' there, but I didn't ask to be there -- she asked me to be there. So, we were late. It was showin' though -- snow was knee-deep. We were very much late gettin' there. Held up the thing over an hour or and hour and a half or so -- for a hour session. So it made them go over time. So he named me as the culprit, as you might say. He didn't have to do it. You know, I wasn't the leader, I was just there. I don't know if he fined her or not,…
